Amwell Medical Group is dedicated to the practice of telehealth, delivering high-quality healthcare to patients on a secure, HIPAA compliant, video-based platform.  + Eliminate the hassles of insurance eligibility, billing and administrative work 
 + Document seamlessly via template-based notes 
 + Prescribe electronically 
 + See patients on a laptop, desktop or iOS device

ViTel Net offers a configurable and interoperable enterprise telehealth platform and point-of-care modules for the entire telehealth continuum of care. Our technology allows clinicians to easily access medical images, patient data, and live video conferencing to remotely diagnose, treat, and manage patients, following patients as they migrated across care settings.

All platforms are connected, eliminating the need to toggle back and forth and fumble with passwords – shattering silos. At the conclusion of the telehealth encounter, the patient records are automatically updated to multiple EHRs, resulting in a single source of record. 
 
As a result, care teams make more informed decisions with greater efficiency. 
 
ViTel Net’s platform allows sharing and aggregation of data between multi-EHR, -PACS, -PHR, and -vendor solutions. This data sharing allows us to provide detailed analytics and reporting, and our clients gain detailed insight into operations of their systems.
 
With our scalable approach, we provide modular telehealth solutions for incremental expansion, as clients add new sites and partners. Our more popular modular solutions include medical imaging, analytics and dashboards, scheduling, and interpreter-on-demand – all of which can be integrated for any specialty (i.e., TeleStroke, Virtual Visits, Clinical Consults, TeleBehavioral Health, and more).

Our mission is simple: to help patients stay healthy and present for the moments that matter most — anniversaries, graduations, family milestones, and everyday life. Because every extra year of health is a gift.

My Virtual Physician is blazing a trail in the telehealth world in the US.

entity.name: Call My Dokter
entity.description:
Indonesia’s GP‑first virtual front door — clinically governed care, cashless referrals, and 20–40% lower health cost leakage.

CallMyDokter is Indonesia’s clinically governed virtual care platform that improves health outcomes, reduces 20–40% cost leakage, and strengthens long‑term patient–doctor relationships. We deliver unlimited GP‑led telemedicine, chronic‑care support, women’s‑health programs, wellness pathways, and seamless referrals through a GP‑first triage model that ensures patients receive the right care at the right time.

Indonesia faces major health and cost challenges: 70% of outpatient costs come from chronic conditions, 50% of sick leave is linked to unmanaged disease, and 1 in 3 women miss work monthly due to menstrual pain. Unmet women’s‑health needs create silent productivity loss, while chat‑based telemedicine produces poor outcomes, low diagnostic accuracy, fragmented care, and unnecessary escalation.

CallMyDokter replaces “any doctor, anytime” chat models with continuous, relationship‑based care. Patients see the same doctor who understands their history, monitors progress, and guides their health journey. This improves outcomes, reduces avoidable claims, and supports healthier, more productive workforces.

We akso work with insurers and TPAs to ensure members are referred to the right physical care when needed, supported by cashless access and integrated claims processes that simplify care for companies and employees. Our platform connects virtual and physical care into one coordinated experience.

Our tools include quality video, online booking system, concierge support, integrated medical records, medication governance, chronic‑care and women’s‑health pathways, seamless referrals, and cashless integration with insurer/TPA networks. Significant value is also achieved through our data‑driven insights that help employers and insurers reduce leakage and improve member outcomes.

CallMyDokter: Better care. Better outcomes. Lower cost.

entity.name: Telemedicine Infectious Disease Solutions
entity.description:
ViTel Net offers a configurable and interoperable enterprise telehealth platform and point-of-care modules for the entire telehealth continuum of care. Our technology allows clinicians to easily access medical images, patient data, and live video conferencing to remotely diagnose, treat, and manage patients, following patients as they migrated across care settings. 
 
ViTel Net’s leadership team is time-tested with real-world experience – clinical, technical, and operational. We understand the healthcare environment and demands and work with our clients to configure telemedicine solutions that are user-friendly with a minimal learning curve, 
 
Our cloud platform – vCareCommand™ – is the “glue” that connects the health IT infrastructure, enabling seamless data and work flow for all care teams. With a single sign-on through the EHR, clinicians can have access to all relevant patient data at their fingertips. All platforms are connected, eliminating the need to toggle back and forth and fumble with passwords – shattering silos. At the conclusion of the telehealth encounter, the patient records are automatically updated to multiple EHRs, resulting in a single source of record. 
 
As a result, care teams make more informed decisions with greater efficiency. 
 
ViTel Net’s platform allows sharing and aggregation of data between multi-EHR, -PACS, -PHR, and -vendor solutions. This data sharing allows us to provide detailed analytics and reporting, and our clients gain detailed insight into operations of their systems.
 
With our scalable approach, we provide modular telehealth solutions for incremental expansion, as clients add new sites and partners. Our more popular modular solutions include medical imaging, analytics and dashboards, scheduling, and interpreter-on-demand – all of which can be integrated for any specialty (i.e., TeleStroke, Virtual Visits, Clinical Consults, TeleBehavioral Health, and more).

Our board-certified physicians in Prevention, Public Health, and Clinical Informatics partner with advanced AI to deliver a personalized 5-year prevention plan for every patient. By integrating medical history, labs, wearables, genomics, and environmental data, we provide a complete view of each individual’s health risks and the steps to reduce them. Patients also have access to optional advanced at-home lab testing through our painless EasyDraw system, and ongoing physician support via our secure mobile app.

We serve people across the country through a fully virtual, HIPAA-compliant clinic. Unlike other wellness solutions, we offer a Non-Bias Guarantee: we never profit from referrals or unnecessary testing. Every recommendation is based only on the latest scientific evidence and what’s right for the patient.

Our mission is simple: to help patients stay healthy and present for the moments that matter most — anniversaries, graduations, family milestones, and everyday life. Because every extra year of health is a gift.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.

  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.

  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.

  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.

Indonesia’s GP‑first virtual front door — clinically governed care, cashless referrals, and 20–40% lower health cost leakage.

Significant value is also achieved through our data‑driven insights that help employers and insurers reduce leakage and improve member outcomes.

CallMyDokter: Better care. Better outcomes. Lower cost.

Dr. Park was able to examine the wound via video on his smartphone, determine it wasn’t serious, and provide care instructions. No emergency visit was necessary, saving his sister lots of time and money. And, voila! The idea for RelyMD was born.

We are proud to help lead the national movement to break down barriers to high-quality, reliable care and participate in the march towards value-based care, right here from our home in Atlanta. High-quality Medical care can be convenient, effective, and on-demand.

entity.name: Call My Dokter

Indonesia’s GP‑first virtual front door — clinically governed care, cashless referrals, and 20–40% lower health cost leakage.

CallMyDokter is Indonesia’s clinically governed virtual care platform that improves health outcomes, reduces 20–40% cost leakage, and strengthens long‑term patient–doctor relationships. We deliver unlimited GP‑led telemedicine, chronic‑care support, women’s‑health programs, wellness pathways, and seamless referrals through a GP‑first triage model that ensures patients receive the right care at the right time.

Indonesia faces major health and cost challenges: 70% of outpatient costs come from chronic conditions, 50% of sick leave is linked to unmanaged disease, and 1 in 3 women miss work monthly due to menstrual pain. Unmet women’s‑health needs create silent productivity loss, while chat‑based telemedicine produces poor outcomes, low diagnostic accuracy, fragmented care, and unnecessary escalation.

CallMyDokter replaces “any doctor, anytime” chat models with continuous, relationship‑based care. Patients see the same doctor who understands their history, monitors progress, and guides their health journey. This improves outcomes, reduces avoidable claims, and supports healthier, more productive workforces.

We akso work with insurers and TPAs to ensure members are referred to the right physical care when needed, supported by cashless access and integrated claims processes that simplify care for companies and employees. Our platform connects virtual and physical care into one coordinated experience.

Our tools include quality video, online booking system, concierge support, integrated medical records, medication governance, chronic‑care and women’s‑health pathways, seamless referrals, and cashless integration with insurer/TPA networks. Significant value is also achieved through our data‑driven insights that help employers and insurers reduce leakage and improve member outcomes.

CallMyDokter: Better care. Better outcomes. Lower cost.

Our board-certified physicians in Prevention, Public Health, and Clinical Informatics partner with advanced AI to deliver a personalized 5-year prevention plan for every patient. Patients also have access to optional advanced at-home lab testing through our painless EasyDraw system, and ongoing physician support via our secure mobile app.

properties.name: EHI's Chronic Care Management (CCM) Solutions and Services
properties.description:
What and Why of Chronic Care Management (CCM).

Chronic Care Management (CCM) is a key constituent of ‘Virtual Health’ enabling Patient-Centric Care. CCM is a catalyst in reducing costs across healthcare systems. CCM also increases the revenues of practices at $44 per patient per month.

•	Over 90% of all healthcare spend goes toward treating people with chronic conditions. 
•	Improving health lead to prevention of secondary complications, reduction in emergency room visits, hospitalizations, and readmissions. 
•	CCM is a proven option that helps manage patients with chronic ailments between office visits.

Chronic Care Management (CCM):

Half of all patients readmitted to hospitals within 30 days had no or minimal post-discharge contact with healthcare professionals. Patients w/ multiple Chronic Conditions have better outcomes when they are given tools to promote better self-care and have a skilled resource to help coordinate care between multiple providers. 

Patients receive better continuity of care when a practice develops a holistic view of patient’s needs related to functional, social, physical, and mental health and provide a point of regular contact for the patient. CCM addresses this gap in care by managing patients between office visits. 

Chronic Care Management assists in care coordination by: 

•	Engage in monthly patient contact
•	Communicate, engage and monitor patients by clinical staff
•	Encourage patients to follow physician-approved care plan
•	Discuss, direct and assist Patients with socio-economic requirements
•	Periodic Medication Reconciliation, assistance with refill requirements; review of adherence and interactions; document any OTC medication consumed
•	24x7 access to clinical staff 
•	Schedule appointments for follow up visits

Simple actions = Positive effects

Greater vigilance by patients w/ chronic conditions is possible and is key to healthier outcomes w/ lower costs. “Care beyond the walls” programs reduce complications.

entity.name: EHI's Chronic Care Management (CCM) Solutions and Services
entity.description:
What and Why of Chronic Care Management (CCM).

Chronic Care Management (CCM) is a key constituent of ‘Virtual Health’ enabling Patient-Centric Care. CCM is a catalyst in reducing costs across healthcare systems. CCM also increases the revenues of practices at $44 per patient per month.

•	Over 90% of all healthcare spend goes toward treating people with chronic conditions. 
•	Improving health lead to prevention of secondary complications, reduction in emergency room visits, hospitalizations, and readmissions. 
•	CCM is a proven option that helps manage patients with chronic ailments between office visits.

Chronic Care Management (CCM):

Half of all patients readmitted to hospitals within 30 days had no or minimal post-discharge contact with healthcare professionals. Patients w/ multiple Chronic Conditions have better outcomes when they are given tools to promote better self-care and have a skilled resource to help coordinate care between multiple providers. 

Patients receive better continuity of care when a practice develops a holistic view of patient’s needs related to functional, social, physical, and mental health and provide a point of regular contact for the patient. CCM addresses this gap in care by managing patients between office visits. 

Chronic Care Management assists in care coordination by: 

•	Engage in monthly patient contact
•	Communicate, engage and monitor patients by clinical staff
•	Encourage patients to follow physician-approved care plan
•	Discuss, direct and assist Patients with socio-economic requirements
•	Periodic Medication Reconciliation, assistance with refill requirements; review of adherence and interactions; document any OTC medication consumed
•	24x7 access to clinical staff 
•	Schedule appointments for follow up visits

Simple actions = Positive effects

Greater vigilance by patients w/ chronic conditions is possible and is key to healthier outcomes w/ lower costs. “Care beyond the walls” programs reduce complications.

Many patients lack the practical tools to navigate daily life and often feel completely alone in their struggle. We are bridging this gap and empowering every patient to take back control of their journey alongside a community of peers who truly understand. 

By replacing cumbersome clinical questionnaires with beautiful, consumer-grade UI/UX, we make tracking life, from diet and medication to mental and physical health, completely effortless.

This deep real-world engagement allows us to capture the most comprehensive, high-frequency longitudinal Real-World Patient-Reported Outcomes in the industry. Starting with the IBD community, we translate the daily lived experience into structured, longitudinal real-world evidence, serving as the premier enabler for the life-science industry to build treatments that finally fit the patient’s real life.

entity.name: Telemedicine Infectious Disease Solutions
entity.description:
ViTel Net offers a configurable and interoperable enterprise telehealth platform and point-of-care modules for the entire telehealth continuum of care. Our technology allows clinicians to easily access medical images, patient data, and live video conferencing to remotely diagnose, treat, and manage patients, following patients as they migrated across care settings. 
 
ViTel Net’s leadership team is time-tested with real-world experience – clinical, technical, and operational. We understand the healthcare environment and demands and work with our clients to configure telemedicine solutions that are user-friendly with a minimal learning curve, 
 
Our cloud platform – vCareCommand™ – is the “glue” that connects the health IT infrastructure, enabling seamless data and work flow for all care teams. With a single sign-on through the EHR, clinicians can have access to all relevant patient data at their fingertips. All platforms are connected, eliminating the need to toggle back and forth and fumble with passwords – shattering silos. At the conclusion of the telehealth encounter, the patient records are automatically updated to multiple EHRs, resulting in a single source of record. 
 
As a result, care teams make more informed decisions with greater efficiency. 
 
ViTel Net’s platform allows sharing and aggregation of data between multi-EHR, -PACS, -PHR, and -vendor solutions. This data sharing allows us to provide detailed analytics and reporting, and our clients gain detailed insight into operations of their systems.
 
With our scalable approach, we provide modular telehealth solutions for incremental expansion, as clients add new sites and partners. Our more popular modular solutions include medical imaging, analytics and dashboards, scheduling, and interpreter-on-demand – all of which can be integrated for any specialty (i.e., TeleStroke, Virtual Visits, Clinical Consults, TeleBehavioral Health, and more).

Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders. 

Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home.

Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, Monogram Health operates in 37 states and is privately held by Frist Cressey Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, TPG Capital, and other leading strategic and financial investors.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.

  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.

  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
